newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese escudo under pressure after French vote.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese escudo under pressure after French vote.

text.p: The escudo opened sharply lower against the German mark after the surprisingly strong showing of the left in first round voting in French elections on Sunday, traders said.
The escudo was down at 101.12/15 to the mark after closing at 100.95/98 on Friday as the French franc, Spanish peseta and Italian lira also lost ground.
There was no immediate sign of Bank of Portugal intervention, although the central bank was seeking prices from banks in a signal that it could eventually step in, traders said.
With most votes counted in metropolitan France, the Interior Ministry said the combined left had polled 40.1 percent, the RPR-UDF coalition and other right-wing candidates 36.5 percent.
If support for the left is confirmed in next week's second round vote, conservative President Jacques Chirac could be forced to appoint a Socialist-led government.
